purpose: Prevent authoritative native-4K evidence from being sealed with an omitted, duplicated, or shader-copy-confounded display transfer. Scene/PBR lighting remains linear through the floating-point HDR image-effect source; the filmic shader outputs linear LDR; the canonical non-HDR sRGB target owns the single Linear-to-sRGB encoding step and is resolved in-place before direct PNG readback.

authoritativeStillTargets.sourceDescriptor: RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32 + sRGB when project color space is Linear + bindMS=false
authoritativeStillTargets.resolveMethod: RenderTexture.ResolveAntiAliasedSurface() in-place on the canonical target when msaaSamples > 1
authoritativeStillTargets.readback: canonical resolved sRGB LDR RenderTexture -> RGB24 Texture2D -> PNG

runtimeGuard.mechanism: InitializeOnLoad Camera.onPreCull fail-closed guard on the authoritative MainCamera targets plus source-bound fixed-function resolve validation

runtimeTelemetryBridge.purpose: The pre-cull target guard alone is insufficient: every actual OnRenderImage invocation must independently observe linear HDR input and sRGB LDR output before the capture manifest may be written.

visualFidelityPolicy.reason: Correct transfer plumbing is necessary for trustworthy pixels but does not prove that the resulting exposure, color, highlight rolloff, material response, fine detail or composition is visually good.

failurePolicy.nativeTargetNotSrgb: FAIL authoritative still before culling and disable required tonemap so runtime receipt cannot seal
failurePolicy.anyOnRenderImageSourceNotLinearHdr: FAIL authoritative packet before manifest write
failurePolicy.anyOnRenderImageDestinationNotSrgbLdr: FAIL authoritative packet before manifest write
failurePolicy.manualTonemapGammaEncodingDetected: FAIL source preflight to prevent double encoding

failureInjectionWhenRunnerAppears: Set canonical QA4K target sRGB=false and require pre-cull rejection plus tonemap disable.
Set bindMS/bindTextureMS=true and require pre-cull rejection.
Reintroduce resolveDescriptor/resolvedTarget and require source preflight failure.
Reintroduce Graphics.Blit(msaaTarget, ...) after tonemap and require source preflight failure.
Remove ResolveAntiAliasedSurface() and require source preflight failure.
After clean recovery, compare fresh native hero/oblique/grazing PNGs and 100% crops for gamma, gradient, highlight and edge artifacts.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTextureReadWrite
researchReferences.use: In Linear color space, non-HDR color render textures normally use sRGB read/write conversion; HDR floating-point formats are always treated as linear data.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTexture.sRGB
researchReferences.use: Runtime read-only property used by the formal MainCamera pre-cull guard and image-effect telemetry to prove the expected display-transfer state.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTexture.ResolveAntiAliasedSurface
researchReferences.use: When the target argument is omitted, Unity resolves an antialiased RenderTexture into itself; this is the authoritative fixed-function resolve path.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTexture.bindTextureMS
researchReferences.use: Raw multisample shader binding disables the normal resolved-surface behavior and is forbidden for formal evidence.
